name: Texas 4-H Council
what_you_do: Speak for the Texas 4-H program across the state. Work with Extension staff to plan and run events. Seats go to district delegates from the twelve AgriLife Extension districts. There are also six At-Large Delegates.
who_can_apply: Older Texas 4-H members. Peers vote for district delegates. Six At-Large Delegates are voted in across the state.
pay_detail: Cost not stated on the program page.
duration: Not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: 2026 Council training was July 27 to 30, 2026 in College Station. Ask your District 4-H Specialist for the district application deadline. The page does not list an At-Large deadline.
how_to_apply: Send in the 2026-2027 At-Large Delegate application and the 2026-2027 Council Membership Contract. Or run in your district. Ask your District 4-H Specialist for the district due date.
notes: All delegates must sign the council contract for 2026-2027. Both kinds of delegate sign it.
